Thanks again for the intro on the partner call. Per our discussion, AssureLink would like to pilot an automated evidence gateway that lets our mutual customers and pen-test vendors push SOC2/attestation artifacts into Redwood's secure staging for periodic review. High-level asks from our side:

- Short-term: S3-compatible upload endpoint + one-time pre-signed link flow for pen-test deliverables (reports, packet captures, signed statement PDFs)
- Long-term: SAML/SCIM for service accounts + KMS-wrapped object encryption; retention policy flagging and an audit log feed (syslog or CloudWatch)
- Security controls: minimum TLS1.2, signed SHA256 checksums on each package, and a redaction workflow for sensitive PII in screenshots

Attached is a first-pass evidence_spec workbook (assurelink_evidence_spec_v1.xlsx) and a sample manifest schema. Can you confirm whether Redwood accepts: (a) pre-signed PUTs to a tenant-scoped bucket, or (b) an API keyed upload to a tenant-backed collector? Laura — thanks for the clear outline and the spec.

We can support both pre-signed S3 uploads (tenant-scoped buckets) and an API tokened collector endpoint. Quick answers:
- Pre-signed TTL: default 48h, can be configured per-tenant; we generally avoid >7d for security.
- KMS: we support customer-managed CMEK for Private deployments and KMS-wrapped objects for Hosted with RBAC
- Audit feed: we can push digest events to a customer syslog endpoint or S3/CloudWatch; full token-level logs are available in Redwood Console for Dedicated customers

- Vanessa: can you scope a 30m dry-run and confirm who'll own the test tenant? (Vanessa, cc'd)
